namespace: Array and ListWithDetail Control item-label data path
default: first primitive item property when available, otherwise an index label
effect: reads an item-relative data path for each collection item's visible label without changing item data or identity
precedence: selected Control local elementLabelProp precedes local legacy childLabelProp and generated fallback; removed global elementLabelProp is not a common default

namespace: Legacy array Control item-label data-path alias
default: absent; falls back to the first primitive item property or index
effect: when no local elementLabelProp is present, reads an item-relative path for the collection item label without changing stored data
precedence: selected Control local childLabelProp applies only without local elementLabelProp; removed global childLabelProp is not a common default
consumer: packages/jsonforms-svelte-{flowbite,shadcn,skeleton}/src/lib/util/composition.svelte.ts, used by array item headers and ListWithDetail
